notes.title: Forging fixes
notes.notes: Bug fixing is in progress at the highest possible speed — we’ve released another fix just today solving some popular issues like sprite duplication in some scenes, glossary and icons. Other bugs are in the works, too. During several upcoming days we will release many small fixes, so don’t forget to grab the latest version on Steam. Once again — thank you for all the bug reports, they really help. Have a nice week!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — release stream
notes.notes:
Alongside with [b]The Tales of Bayun[/b] launch we stream the very beginning of the first episode once again!

Wanna unfold the story in your own way, huh? Then try the demo!

Want even more? The full game is out now!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun goes live!
notes.notes:
The time has come — [b]The Tales of Bayun [/b]is finally available on Steam!

Set off on a remarkable journey in a fascinating world based on slavic myths and legends! Reveal the secrets of the darkest rituals and discover who is the [b]“Bride of the Poloz”[/b]. Find the reason behind the deadly disease and question the essence of humanism in the [b]“White Plague”[/b]. And don’t get fooled by the Bayun — this fuzzy little trickster, who has certainly aimed to eat you!

Your amazing stories are about to begin!

P.S. Please, start a new game in the full version of The Tales of Bayun and do not load the save files from the demo version in order to avoid potential errors and mistakes.

notes.title: Just a few hours until the release!
notes.notes:
[b]The Tales of Bayun[/b] will release on [b]February 16 at 7:00 AM (UTC)[/b].

It has been an arduous but awesome journey for our team and we are proud of the upcoming game. It is made by fans of narrative-driven games for those who love fascinating stories, interesting characters and hard choices. Hope you will like it, too! 

See you soon at the Side!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
The Year 2022 is coming to an end. It was a harsh time for all of us, including a small indie-team that decided to make their own narrative adventure game in a slavish setting. Such a great amount of difficulties and tricks of fortune deserve its own book. Perhaps we will even write it some day. But nevertheless the amount of great moments was even higher! 

We’ve assembled a great team full of experienced and talented people. Discovered a brand new world of slavish myths and legends, so deep and diverse that it is even hard to imagine. Created a fully playable version of the game from sketches and concepts. Attended a bunch of events and fests. Visited many great places. Connected with many people from gamedev. And above all — got ourselves familiar with all of you, friends! All your interest, curiosity, support, criticism, ideas and suggestions gave us strength during the whole development process. There are still some important steps to be done, but we are eager to say one thing: thank you! Without our great community this game would not even exist. 

In the upcoming year we wish you pure happiness. To love and to be loved. To seek knowledge and to strive for improvements. To explore new horizons, to gain fresh and stimulating experiences. Especially those in small indie games, made with love and great care.

Happy New Year and see you in 2023!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3CnB9fn.png[/img]

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — release date
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are finally ready to announce the release date.

[b]The Tales of Bayun[/b] will go live on the [b]16th February 2023[/b]. 

In fact both episodes are complete and the game is playable from the beginning till the very end. But localization, testing and polishing are still to be done. Moreover releasing a title at the end of December / the beginning of January will result in competing with many AAA products and different games from the winter sales. 

We will spend the remaining time to guarantee the best quality of The Tales of Bayun and to implement some ideas and improvements that we could not even start due to the lack of time. Yet more information and pleasant surprises are about to come, so stay tuned. Once again, thank you all for the support and interest in our debut game — this means a lot for our team!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — demo update, event results and new information
notes.notes:
While other people try to disguise themselves into vampires, witches and other supernatural creatures, our team works our  tail off with [b]The Tales of Bayun[/b]. And we have some information to share!

[b]First of all[/b], we’ve once again [b]updated the demo[/b]: added a new map, descriptions, dialogue lines and even several dialogue branches, updated animations, visual effects and fixed some bugs. 

[b]Secondly[/b], we have finally [b]summarized the Streamers and Video-makers event[/b]. This time the [b]winner[/b] is [b]Anna Shepard[/b], congratulations! We’ve also decided to honor [b]DamRiele[/b], [b]Victoria Engine[/b] and [b]GamerDotCom[/b] for their previous videos, thank you for such amazing content. All mentioned creators will receive The Tales of Bayun Steam key at the time of the full release.

[b]Thirdly[/b], we decided to [b]keep the Streamers initiative going[/b]. From time to time we will browse related YouTube videos and award the most appealing to our team authors with free game keys. Perhaps, one of those will be given to you!

[b]Finally[/b], we are ready to [b]pull back the curtain on The Tales of Bayun second episode[/b]. Here is the very first screenshot! Do you have any suggestions about the plot or the characters? Feel free to discuss them! We will share even more information later on, but as for now — [b]have a great Halloween[/b]!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — second stream
notes.notes:
It's Saturday already... 

Time to take a break from all the worries and troubles of the world we live in. Here, take a sit and listen to some stories of mine. You won't regret it. Huh? What about a happy ending..? For you must know not all stories are bright and sweet. But the ending... It depends on all the choices and actions. 

Let's have a brief look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935470/The_Tales_of_Bayun/]The Tales of Bayun[/url]!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — stream
notes.notes:
Greetings, strangers! 

Don't be scared, grab a seat by the fire and open your eyes wide. You are about to witness the beginning of the story... Choices are made and the destiny is foretold. 

Wanna unfold it in your own way, huh? Then try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935470/The_Tales_of_Bayun/]demo[/url]!

notes.title: The Tales of Bayun comes to China!
notes.notes:
Great news amid the week! 

More and more people fall in love with [b]The Tales of Bayun[/b] everyday. The game even got some attention from China and we are happy to announce that [b]The Tales of Bayun[/b] will be available there with the help of the local publisher.

This fact does not affect our current state or development progression. We still do our best to finish the game and will publish it manually across the globe. But now even more people will get in touch with amazing Bayun’s stories!
